craft_notes: Sthāyin: Love pleading through dread (rati under fear). Comma splits filming from rinsing. Rejected: 'wash' for 'rinse' — rinse is choicer; kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: For god-sight filmed with birth-born stain's eclipse,
in rinse, lord, thy love is sovereign salve.
l4.sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam

reads_against.argmap: For the divine knowledge-eye blinded by māyā-made stain. → Devotion to you is supreme ointment purifying the blinded eye.
c1_essence: Love the last salve rinsing filmed god-sight.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śṛṅgāra-bhakti with karuṇā (love pleading through dread)

l2.plain_english: For god-sight filmed with inborn stain, lord, your love is the last salve that rinses clean.
l2.sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam
